# maisongr-sitemap

> An open-source npm package (MIT, no runtime dependencies, Node 20.9+) that gives a website one sitemap with two readers. Search engines get standard XML at /sitemap.xml. A person opening the same address gets a page in the site's own colours, fonts and dark mode, without XSLT.

It detects the framework, finds the pages, dates each one from Git, reads the theme and writes one route file. A browser opening a page sends `Sec-Fetch-Dest: document`, and crawlers never do: that header decides which answer is served. Both list the same addresses.

## Set it up

Run from the project's root, then do what the report's Next section says.

- Next.js, Astro with an adapter, SvelteKit, Nuxt: `npx maisongr-sitemap init`, then `npm install maisongr-sitemap`
- Astro without an adapter, adapter-static, nuxt generate, Vite and Create React App: `npx maisongr-sitemap init --site https://your.site`, then `npm install --save-dev maisongr-sitemap`
- Express, Connect, Polka, node:http: `npx maisongr-sitemap init` in the server's folder, then list the addresses in `sitemap.js` and mount it
- Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno, React Router: call `createSitemap` from `maisongr-sitemap` with a Request
- A built static site: `npx maisongr-sitemap static dist --site https://your.site`
- PHP, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, .NET, a CMS: `npx maisongr-sitemap crawl http://localhost:8000 --out public --site https://your.site`

## Replace another sitemap

`npx maisongr-sitemap init --replace` takes over from next-sitemap, @astrojs/sitemap, @nuxtjs/sitemap, super-sitemap, svelte-sitemap, a hand-written route, or an XSLT-styled sitemap in the public folder. It moves the old files to `.sitemap-replaced/`, deletes nothing, and prints the `npm uninstall` line to run.

## For AI agents

- `--json` on any command prints one report on stdout. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 stopped with a reason, 2 a bug in the tool.
- No command waits for input. `connect` changes robots.txt only with `--yes`.
- `npx skills add maison-gr/sitemap` installs the Agent Skill.
- `npx maisongr-sitemap mcp` serves the commands as tools over MCP (stdio), in the folder it starts in.
